name.ja: ＭＧ 1/100 真武者頑駄無 戦国の陣 黒衣大鎧
name.en: MG 1/100 Shinmusha Gundam Sengoku Jin Black Clothes Large Armor

description.ja: 鎧　袖　一　触
description.en: armor sleeve one touch

description.ja: 黒 衣 大 鎧 纏 い て
description.en: Wearing black clothes and large armor

description.ja: い ざ 、 出 陣 の 刻
description.en: It's time to go to battle

description.ja: 「MG 1/100 真武者頑駄無 戦国の陣」が、ガンプラオリジナルカラーにて装いを新たに商品化。
description.en: "MG 1/100 Shinmusha Gundam Sengoku Jin" has been commercialized with a new look in Gunpla original colors.

description.ja: 特徴的な大鎧を黒を基調としたカラーリングに一新。新規描き下ろしの屏風や彼岸花をあしらった和柄のシールが付属。
description.en: The characteristic large armor has been redesigned to a black-based coloring. Comes with a newly drawn folding screen and a Japanese-patterned Seal featuring red spider lilies.

description.ja: ●　オリジナルカラー“黒衣大鎧”を纏い見参！
description.en: ●Visit wearing the original color “Kuroi Ooiro”!

description.ja: 黒を基調とした大鎧のカラーリングを成形色で一新。
description.en: The coloring of the large armor, which is based on black, has been renewed with molding colors.

description.ja: 赤い外装部はメッキ加工を施し、シルバーの外装部にはメタリック成形色を採用。装備類も本体カラーに合わせた配色で再現！
description.en: The red exterior part is plated, and the silver exterior part uses metallic molding color. The equipment is also reproduced in a color scheme that matches the main body color!

description.ja: ●　特殊素材「和シール」が付属
description.en: ● Comes with special material "Wa Seal"

description.ja: 和紙のような加工を施した「和スタイルオリジナルステッカー」が付属。妖しく煌く彼岸花をあしらった新規柄を収録。
description.en: Comes with a "Japanese style original sticker" that has been processed to look like Japanese paper. Contains a new pattern featuring mysteriously sparkling spider lilies.

description.ja: ●　豪華“陣”を飾る多彩な装飾品が付属
description.en: ● Comes with a variety of decorations to decorate the luxurious "camp"

description.ja: 節句仕様の各種武器を展示する台座やスタンド類、屏風や木札風ネームプレートなど多彩な装飾品が付属。
description.en: Includes a variety of accessories such as pedestals and stands for displaying various seasonal weapons, folding screens, and wooden name plates.

description.ja: 森下直親氏描き下ろし“銀屏風”が同梱！
description.en: A “silver folding screen” drawn by Naochika Morishita is included!

description.ja: 数々のガンプラボックスアートを手掛ける森下直親氏描き下ろしの屏風絵シートが付属。
description.en: Includes a folding screen picture sheet drawn by Naochika Morishita, who has created many Gunpla box art pieces.

description.ja: 龍と鳳凰が描かれた屏風絵シートには銀の箔押し加工が施され、重厚感ある“銀屏風”を再現。
description.en: The folding screen picture sheet depicting a dragon and a phoenix is ​​stamped with silver foil to recreate the profound feeling of a "silver folding screen."

description.ja: 木札風ネームプレートは新規筆文字デザインの箔押しシールで再現！
description.en: The wooden name plate is reproduced with a foil-stamped seal with a new calligraphy design!

description.ja: ●　新規デザインフルカラーパッケージでお届け！
description.en: ● Delivered in a newly designed full color package!

description.ja: 〈セット内容〉： 真武者頑駄無 戦国の陣 黒衣大鎧 ／ 太刀 ／ 火砲 ／ 槍 ／ 薙刀
description.en: 〈Set contents〉: Shinmusha Gundam Sengoku no Jin Black Clothes Armor / Long Sword / Artillery / Spear / Naginata

description.ja: ／ 飾り台座 ／ 屏風 ／ 木札風ネームプレート ／ スタンド（槍・薙刀用、火砲・太刀用）
description.en: ／ Decorative pedestal ／ Folding screen ／ Wooden name plate ／ Stand (for spears and naginata, for firearms and long swords)
